# Topic Desk Studio v0.4.0 — English

This update adds source connectivity diagnostics, floating topic navigation, and automatic connection recovery.

- Test one source or all sources from Settings, see the actual connection route, and review a completion summary. Successful tests turn the source indicator green.
- Recover from collection connection failures by trying the other available route between Direct and the saved proxy. Exhausted sources record an error while collection continues with other sources.
- Prefer Direct for the official DeepSeek API, with one saved-proxy retry if the connection cannot be established.
- Browse collapsed topics through a floating rail on the left of the article. Hover to preview a title and source, then click to read in a new tab. Markers remain visible on light and dark pages without reserving article space.
- Automatically restore the topic list after closing the last reading tab.
- Confirm before restoring default sources and use consistent buttons across confirmation dialogs.
- Add source connection troubleshooting to the English and Chinese READMEs.

---

# Topic Desk Studio v0.4.0 — 中文

本次更新新增数据源连通性测试、悬浮话题导航与连接自动恢复。

- 在设置中测试单个或全部数据源，查看实际连接方式，完成后弹窗汇总；测试成功的来源圆点变绿。
- 采集遇到连接问题时，在直连与已保存的代理之间尝试另一种方式；可用方式均失败后记录报错，继续采集其他来源。
- DeepSeek 官方接口优先直连，建立连接失败时通过已保存的代理重试一次。
- 收起选题后，阅读区左侧显示悬浮话题短线；悬停预览标题和来源，点击在新页签阅读。适配深浅网页，不挤占文章宽度。
- 关闭最后一个阅读页签后，自动展开选题列表。
- 恢复默认来源前显示确认弹窗，统一各类确认弹窗的按钮样式。
- 在中英文 README 中补充数据源连接常见问题与排查步骤。
